system.description:
Survive in hostile environments or conditions. Each level adds protection against one type.

  • Level 1: Resilient to 1 environment or condition
  • Level 2: Resilient to 2 environments or conditions
  • Level 3: Resilient to 3 environments or conditions
  • Level 4: Resilient to 4 environments or conditions
  • Level 5: Resilient to 5 environments or conditions
  • Level 6: Resilient to 6 environments or conditions
